$comment: Particle-accelerator balance data (MOD-077 / engine.accelerator, FEAT-098 / feat.particleaccelerator — spec: resources-design-brief.md §8 'End-game and mega-facilities'; METROPOLIS-MASTER-v2.1.md §MP 'Hadron Research Ring'). GR#15: every magnitude this feature leaves unquantified lives here, never as a Go literal in internal/engine/accelerator/*.go. GR#3: the electricity/water DRAW magnitudes themselves are NOT duplicated here — they are the product of data/consumption.json's 'accelerator' class coefficients (§17.2 coefficient row) and this file's facilityThroughput; this file carries only the throughput, the peak/base split, and the research/health/FDI/prestige/threshold figures. Every numeric value below is a placeholder pending Aaron's balance pass (balance-number regime) and carries a non-empty disclosure in 'disclosures' naming it as such.

meta.balanceRegime: every numeric value is a placeholder pending Aaron's balance pass; acceptance tests assert direction/structure, never a specific magnitude
meta.drawUnits: electricity draw = data/consumption.json 'accelerator' class elecKWh (kWh per facility per day) x facilityThroughput; peak = base x electricityPeakMultiplier. Water draw = the same class's waterL (litres per facility per day) x facilityThroughput; 1000 L = 1 m3. So the draw is expressed in kWh/day (electricity) and m3/day (water) with an explicit peak/base split carried by electricityPeakMultiplier.

units.facilityThroughput: facility count (occupancy scaling the consumptionRef class coefficients; 1 = one accelerator)
units.researchRateMultiplier: dimensionless multiplier applied to engine.education's research output
units.healthSpillover: wellbeing-track points added per tick (0-100 track scale)
units.fdiAnchorDraw: prospect-figure points added to engine.fdi's queryable prospect figure
units.prestigeBase: prestige points granted once the facility is operational (integer)
units.prestigePerTick: prestige points accumulated per tick while operational (integer)
units.expertGateThreshold: research points (engine.education research-output units) required to pass the expert gate

disclosures.facilityThroughput: placeholder pending Aaron's balance pass — a CERN-class facility is modelled as a single unit; throughput is the occupancy knob, not a spec figure
disclosures.electricityPeakMultiplier: placeholder pending Aaron's balance pass — §8 gives no peak/base ratio for a CERN-class facility
disclosures.researchRateMultiplier: placeholder pending Aaron's balance pass — §MP's 'research rate xx' is unquantified
disclosures.healthSpillover: placeholder pending Aaron's balance pass — §8 gives no research-to-health spillover magnitude
disclosures.fdiAnchorDraw: placeholder pending Aaron's balance pass — §46 gives no anchor-prospect draw magnitude
disclosures.prestigeBase: placeholder pending Aaron's balance pass — §MP's 'prestige' is unquantified
disclosures.prestigePerTick: placeholder pending Aaron's balance pass — §MP's 'prestige' is unquantified
disclosures.expertGateThreshold: placeholder pending Aaron's balance pass — §8's 'large workforce of highly trained experts' is unquantified
